newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA MAY USE EURO IN FIVE YEARS-C.BANK.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA MAY USE EURO IN FIVE YEARS-C.BANK.

text.p: Estonian central bank president Vahur Kraft said there was a high possibility that in five years the European monetary union currency unit the euro would be in use in Estonia, daily Eesti Paevaleht said on Wednesday.
"This possibility is big enough although some question marks have emerged in regard to the future of monetary union," Kraft was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
"Estonia is...ready to join the European Union and European monetary union if we are given that opportunity," he said.
Kraft said that one of the most serious models for the countries who will not join the monetary union in the first stage is a fixed rate against the euro.
"Estonia has already now very good preconditions to apply such a system," Kraft added.
